title: Northstar-to-Sprint Adapter and Commitment Contract
creator: Ava Thompson
description: Why: As Redwood scales, company-level OKRs are too high level for teams to turn into predictable sprint work. Teams either over-commit to vanity tasks or under-commit to outcome-driven slices, which creates brittle delivery and missed cross-functional dependencies. This ticket creates a lightweight operational adapter: a templated "Northstar-to-Sprint" mapping plus a formalized "Commitment Contract" ritual that converts company OKRs and initiatives into measurable, testable sprint-level commitments across Eng, Product, Design, and Reliability.
background: Current state: leadership defines company OKRs and assigns initiative owners. Teams receive initiative briefs but lack a consistent mapping process to translate metrics (KPIs) into sprint deliverables and success signals. In the last two quarters we've observed 18% variance between planned and delivered initiative milestones due to mis-scoped slices and missing cross-team dependency negotiation.
goal: Deliver a repeatable playbook and lightweight tooling that: 1) maps each company-level key result to 2-3 cross-functional sprint deliverables, 2) exposes expected signal metrics for each slice, and 3) establishes a single-week 'commitment window' prior to planning where teams negotiate and sign the Commitment Contract.
acceptance_criteria:
- Playbook document published in Confluence with templates and examples for three sample initiatives (runtime performance, console rollout, dedicated autoscale).
- Ship a Commitment Contract template (Google Doc) that captures scope, success metric, fallbacks, and owners.
- Pilot run completed with three teams during 2025-Q1 planning cycle and signed contracts in 100% of pilot teams.
- A dashboard saved in Console that surfaces top-level OKR -> slice mappings and ownership links.
milestones: 1) Draft playbook and templates (by 2025-01-20). 2) Cross-functional review workshops (2025-01-22 and 2025-01-29). 3) Pilot Commitment Window during Cycle planning (2025-02-05 to 2025-02-12). 4) Retro & iterate (by 2025-02-20).
plan: Phase A: Internal design of templates and two-hour workshop with Eng leads, PMs, Designers, and Reliability SREs. Phase B: Pilot with three initiative teams (runtime batching, dedicated autoscale, console rollouts). Phase C: Iterate on feedback and push to company playbook and onboarding docs. Deliverable: confluence playbook, doc templates, one saved console dashboard, and a short how-to video.
risks_and_mitigations:
Risk: Teams will treat the Contract as busywork. Mitigation: keep template lean (one page), require only top-level metric and fallback, and have Exec sponsor review for pilot teams.
Risk: Dependencies not surfaced in time. Mitigation: require dependency field in the contract and a weekly dependency triage queue owned by PM Ops.
measurement: Primary metric: reduction in initiative milestone variance from planning to end-of-cycle (target: reduce variance from 18% to <8% in pilot). Secondary metrics: % of pilot teams with signed contract (target 100%), time spent in negotiation window (target <3 days average), and number of post-planning scope changes attributed to missed dependencies (target: -50%).
